description: SessionStart preflight. Checks that GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR is set and really is a Ghidra install root, that a JDK 21+ is on PATH, and that a Ghidra project is configured — the four environmental failures that would otherwise surface only as an opaque error on the first tool call. Silent when everything is in order, and never blocks: it always exits 0. Registered per source rather than with a wildcard so it does not re-report after every context compaction.
